name: fabius-pitch-video
description: Fabius pitch video, Motion-as-Code style, rendered with Remotion. Every frame is a pure function of the frame number, timed by the voiceover's word timings.

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Fabius out/fabius-pitch.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:draft: remotion render src/index.ts Fabius out/fabius-pitch-draft.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 26 --scale 0.5
